limitations: This concerns encoding or parsing a core module. A well-formed encoding is separate from module validation. The source-file wrapper abbreviation and testing-tool commands have different scopes.

triggers: Material W3C correction, a change of edition mapping, different exact source bytes, or contrary governing evidence.

statement: In the W3C WebAssembly Core 1.0 Recommendation, the binary and text formats map to a common abstract structure. The text format describes a module as an S-expression rendering of its abstract syntax, with well-formed text determined by the text grammar.
